The PDF provides the question and four option pairs (Suaipui and Saihmun, Sanzawl and Bochung, Seipuikhur and Khawkawk, Chawnghawih and Siallam) but does not contain the answer in the extracted text. This is specific Mizo historical information that cannot be verified from the source PDF alone. Answer chosen as (a) Suaipui and Saihmun as the most commonly referenced early Lusei settlement pair, but with low confidence due to inability to confirm from source.
